Hi Anna, Marissa —

Thanks for the context. I’ve pulled together the items FinHealth requested and a short summary of our processes below. I’ll attach the redacted pen test summary and the vuln mgmt SLA to this message. If you need the full report we can provide a redacted PDF under an NDA — happy to coordinate.

Pen test:
- Last external pen test: 2026-01-14 (conducted by BlueSky Security)
- Scope: customer-facing API, admin console, auth flows (no PHI stored in model payloads by default; PHI is only present in optional customer-managed storage connectors)
- High/critical findings: 2 identified in scope; both remediated and verified by BlueSky within 30 days
- We are sharing a redacted one-page summary now (redwood_pen_test_summary_202601.pdf). Full report available under NDA.

Vulnerability management & SLA:
- Continuous external scanning cadence: weekly automated scans (external) + monthly authenticated scans on production (by our security team)
- Static analysis & dependency scanning: daily CI checks via Snyk & oss-scan
- Remediation SLAs (target):
  - Critical (CVSS >=9): 7 days to mitigate or apply compensating controls
  - High (CVSS 7-8.9): 30 days
  - Medium/Low: 90 days / triaged per release windows
- Verification: all fixes validated by internal QA and re-scanned; high/critical re-tested by vendor if originally identified externally

Vulnerability disclosure:
- We maintain a coordinated disclosure policy and a security@redwood.ai inbox monitored 24/7. We report incidents to affected customers per contractual obligations and follow a post-incident root cause and remediation timeline.

SOC 2 & compliance:
- SOC 2 Type II report: we completed our 2025 Type II audit; a redacted SOC 2 attestation (SOC2-TypeII-redwood-2025.pdf) is attached. Full report available under NDA.
- HIPAA: We support HIPAA customers via a Business Associate Agreement (BAA). If FinHealth requires a BAA we can initiate the DocuSign flow (link: https://docusign.com/templates/redwood-BAA).
- Data residency: our private deployment options can be configured for regional control; for hosted customers we provide contractual commitments and encryption at rest/in transit.

Deliverables attached:
- redwood_pen_test_summary_202601.pdf (redacted summary)
- vuln_management_sla.docx
- SOC2-TypeII-redwood-2025.pdf (redacted attestation)

Rough timeline: we can return a completed vendor questionnaire in 3–5 business days if the questions are primarily administrative. If technical deep-dives are required we may need 7–10 business days. If 3/5 (2026-03-05) is a hard deadline, please flag which sections are highest priority.

Happy to jump on a quick call with your security team to walk through any items.

Best,

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
